_note: VA Capital is confirmed as title sponsor. The remaining tiers and their sponsors are still PENDING from JMCC — the TODO_ tier below is the template for them and renders nothing until its placeholders are replaced.
_layout_rules: Static tiered grid — NO carousel. Higher tiers get larger logo cells. All logos in uniform cream/white cards with consistent padding so mismatched logo shapes read as intentional. Links open in a new tab with rel=noopener.
_filename_rules: Rename every logo file to sponsor-<name>.png. The old Wix site shipped assets literally named 'Screenshot 2025-05-18 at 7.27.48 PM.png' — none of those filenames survive the migration.

body.en: Our sponsors make it possible for JMSB students to compete on the world stage.
body.fr: Nos commanditaires permettent aux étudiants de JMSB de compétitionner sur la scène mondiale.
